Legacy command intent:

ViewBS MethOverRegion --sample data/test_data/test_WT.tab.gz,WT --region regions.bed --outdir out --prefix over --context CG --minDepth 1 --maxDepth 100 --flank 10 --binLength 5 --binNumber 5 --minLength 1 --maxLength 1000000

Expected output provenance:

The local legacy Perl entrypoint cannot be executed in this environment because Getopt::Long::Subcommand is not installed. This fixture uses the checked-in indexed methylation fixture data/test_data/test_WT.tab.gz and follows the checked-in legacy implementation in lib/Meth/OverRegion.pm:

- parse BED-like regions with strand;
- query body plus flanks;
- preserve upstream/body/downstream bin assignment;
- aggregate C/T counts per sample, segment, and bin.
